concepts.title: SCP тюрьма
concepts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image is the EDIT TARGET, a Roblox game screenshot. Produce ONE complete landscape screenshot paintover concept, not a collage. Preserve exactly its elevated camera, perspective, long straight road from bottom left to upper right, road width and length, existing low perimeter wall positions, large circular boss arena attached on the left and small far-right arena, far continuation road, tiny existing characters and all HUD/interface elements with their positions and numbers. Retheme the MAIN road biome and its attached arenas only. Same inexpensive low-poly blocky Roblox visual fidelity and simple matte materials as reference. Readable moderate illumination, no photorealism, no cinematic haze or excessive darkness. Building modules must be VERY SHALLOW front-to-back, elongated PARALLEL to perimeter walls, no more than 8% of road width deep. Place them tightly against walls. No roof over road or arena. Modest sparse individual props ON road's side lanes, clear central 60% walking path, no giant obstacles, no clutter, no green puddles, no new monsters. Remove mine-specific rocks, timber, ore, minecarts and replace them with the specified theme. Keep cyan surrounding void except where theme explicitly overrides it. No title or explanatory text outside game UI.
THEME: SCP containment prison corridor. Light-medium grey concrete floor, narrow white center stripe, graphite steel wall panels and long shallow containment-cell facades with barred viewing windows and heavy numbered vault doors. Small restrained orange hazard stripes and red alarm lamps at doors, security cameras, wall conduits. Sparse props: two short concrete security barriers on side lanes, a small security trolley and two crates. Arena becomes a circular containment chamber with steel walls, yellow-black caution rim and floor containment rings, existing boss position preserved. Clean readable grey/orange/red palette, industrial rather than medieval prison. Bright enough to read geometry.
